sub_area: Scheduler event doctype (stub, no test methods)
rationale: This is an empty stub class with no test methods. Scheduler events are background Python infrastructure that ferro does not reimplement.

sub_area: security.txt generation logic and validation in SecuritySettings doctype
rationale: Tests call frappe.get_doc() directly to check Python-side validation methods (public_policy_section, public_contacts_section, security.txt rendering) — this is in-process Python controller logic that ferro does not reimplement.

sub_area: Server script execution: DocType events, API scripts, permission queries, rate limiting, scheduling
rationale: Server scripts are a Python safe-exec subsystem that pure ferro deliberately does not implement; some tests make HTTP calls to script-registered API endpoints but those only work via Python execution (ferrod might handle via pyfall, not pure ferro).

sub_area: Session defaults applied at document insert time
rationale: Tests set session defaults via in-process Python and verify field values on inserted docs; this is Python-side request-context session logic that ferro does not model.

sub_area: SMS log doctype (stub, no test methods)
rationale: Empty stub class with no test methods. SMS/communication subsystem is outside ferro's scope.

sub_area: SMS settings doctype (stub, no test methods)
rationale: Empty stub class with no test methods. SMS settings is outside ferro's scope.

sub_area: Background submission and cancellation via RQ job queue
rationale: Tests enqueue submission/cancellation via RQ background workers and poll job status — this is Python background-job infrastructure that ferro's in-process jobs.rs does not replicate at the same fidelity level.

sub_area: System settings doctype (stub, no test methods)
rationale: Empty stub class with no test methods. System settings configuration is Python-side singleton CRUD that does not exercise ferro's HTTP surface.

sub_area: Translation doctype: i18n string lookups, parent language fallback, HTML sanitization of translations
rationale: Tests call frappe._() directly to verify in-process translation cache behavior; the translation engine is Python-side and never exposed as a ferro REST endpoint.

sub_area: User CRUD, user type logic, password reset flow, signup, rate limiting, mention parsing
rationale: User creation/deletion and role assignment are ORM operations ferro must handle; password reset and signup involve session/email flows outside ferro's pure-Rust scope, so only the CRUD behaviors are relevant to ferro.

sub_area: User impersonation via whitelisted method over HTTP (FrappeAPITestCase)
rationale: Impersonation calls frappe.core.doctype.user.user.impersonate via HTTP then checks get_logged_user — this is a session-mutating action that relies on sid session state which ferro does not implement.

sub_area: User group doctype (stub, no test methods)
rationale: Empty stub class with no test methods. User group management is in-process Python CRUD outside ferro's explicit scope.

sub_area: User group member doctype (stub, no test methods)
rationale: Empty stub class with no test methods. User group membership is not part of ferro's permission model.

sub_area: User invitation lifecycle: invite by email, accept/cancel/expire, API endpoints
rationale: User invitation flow is email-driven Python logic (invite_by_email, mark_expired_invitations, email queue); these are Python controller behaviors ferro does not reimplement.

sub_area: User permission rules: apply_to_all, applicable_for, nested doctypes, field defaults
rationale: User permissions directly affect which documents are visible via ferro's permission gate in auth.rs/orm.rs; the tests are in-process but encode the permission filtering contract ferro must honor when serving list/get requests.

sub_area: Custom user types: select permission auto-propagation and default print/share/email perms
rationale: User type definitions shape which DocPerms get created and are thus relevant to ferro's permission checks, but the auto-propagation logic itself is Python controller behavior not reimplemented in ferro.

sub_area: HTML diff generation utility functions for Version doctype
rationale: Pure unit tests of Python helper functions (_generate_html_diff, _as_string, _should_generate_html_diff) that are internal to the Version doctype controller; ferro does not implement versioning.

sub_area: Document version tracking: diff generation on save, onload HTML diffs
rationale: Version creation on document save and onload diff rendering are Python DocType event behaviors that ferro does not reimplement; these tests exercise the Python version controller entirely in-process.

sub_area: View log insertion when getdoc is called
rationale: Tests that frappe.desk.form.load.getdoc() records a ViewLog entry — this is a Python-side side-effect of form loading not replicated by ferro's REST/desk layer.

sub_area: Database storage usage report querying table sizes
rationale: Tests a Python script report that queries SQLite/MySQL information_schema for table sizes; report execution is a Python subsystem ferro does not reimplement.
